summary: The Interative AI Notepad for Meetings Discussion | Link
content: Sorinai is an interactive AI notepad that actually works with you during the call. It takes notes alongside you: Fills in your note templates automatically as the call goes, enhances your notes based on what you wrote down, and lets you download a filled version of your word of pdf document. Answers anything you ask in real time: "What did that acronym mean?" "Is what they just said true?" "What should I ask next?" — the private help you'd never ask out loud. Available on Mac and Windows.
chineseSummary: 用于会议讨论的交互式 AI 记事本 |关联
chineseContent: Sorinai 是一款交互式 AI 记事本，可在通话过程中与您实际协作。它会在您身边做笔记：在通话时自动填写您的笔记模板，根据您写下的内容增强您的笔记，并让您下载 Word 或 pdf 文档的填充版本。实时回答您提出的任何问题：“这个缩写是什么意思？” “他们刚才说的是真的吗？” “接下来我该问什么？” — 您永远不会大声要求的私人帮助。适用于 Mac 和 Windows。
